name: Nijisanji no Type Shindan
original_name: にじさんじのタイプ診断
source:
Nijisanji no Type Shindan is a casual personality assessment game based on the VTuber agency Nijisanji. There are "11 + 1" results available to tell you which Nijisanji member your personality is similar to.

----

The class president Tsukino Mito tries to run a personality test on the player by using a crystal ball that she purchased for 20,000 yen, and the player gets trapped inside the crystal ball, as soon as Mito starts her ritual. There, the player experiences a series of short stories involving multiple fictional settings. For example, a story where you become friends with a VTuber, and a story where you work as a producer of an idol. You’ll make several choices along the way, and once all the short stories/tests are complete, you can escape from the crystal ball’s world.

[Edited from [url=https://automaton-media.com/en/news/20211018-4272/]Automaton West[/url]]
translation:
《彩虹社性格診斷》是一部以虛擬實況主團體彩虹社為主題的休閒性格測試遊戲。遊戲共有「11＋1」種結果，會告訴你，自己的性格與哪位彩虹社成員相似。

----

班長月之美兔打算用花了兩萬日圓買來的水晶球，為玩家做一次性格測試。然而，儀式剛一開始，玩家就被困進了水晶球。在那裡，玩家將經歷一系列發生於不同虛構背景的短篇故事，例如與虛擬實況主成為朋友，或擔任偶像製作人。你需要在途中作出多次選擇，等所有短篇故事與測試結束後，才能逃出水晶球的世界。

[編譯自[url=https://automaton-media.com/en/news/20211018-4272/]Automaton West[/url]]
